items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I recorded one time with Charlie Barnett's big band on trumpet in some studio downtown.

ctx.x: And I don't know about the network
studios, but I know that I recorded one time with Charlie Barnett's big band on trumpet in some studio downtown.

I think this is the case, as perhaps frequently happens, that journalists, jazz critics and historians are looking for firsts, looking for all kinds of sharp distinctions when something -- as we discussed earlier -- when something began, and when another thing began, and maybe it's a big exaggerated.
